title: Ali and the Bus
text:
Ali wants to go to the city centre. He looks at the map. The map shows the bus stop near his house. The bus number is 12.

The timetable says the bus leaves at 9:00 every morning. Ali arrives at the bus stop at 8:50. He waits for ten minutes and then he takes the bus.

questions.text: Where does Ali want to go?
What time does the bus leave?
Why does Ali arrive at the bus stop early?
options: He does not want to miss the bus
He wants to buy a new map
He is waiting for a friend

questions.text: Why is the timetable useful for Ali?
options: It tells him when the bus comes
It shows him the city hospital

vocabulary.definition: a drawing that shows roads, streets and places
a list that shows when buses or trains leave and arrive
a place where a bus stops so people can get on or off
the middle part of a town or city

paragraph_translations: Ali şehir merkezine gitmek istiyor. Haritaya bakıyor. Harita, evinin yakınındaki otobüs durağını gösteriyor. Otobüs numarası 12.
Tarifede otobüsün her sabah 9:00'da kalktığı yazıyor. Ali otobüs durağına saat 8:50'de geliyor. On dakika bekliyor ve sonra otobüse biniyor.
